items.raw_excerpt: Family of late Hong Kong Cantopop star says police made ‘no progress’ after three-month investigation, with case causing "immense distress."
items.summary_en: The family of Hong Kong singer Anita Mui says police have made no progress after three months. The urn with her ashes went missing from a monastery on Lantau Island. The family is asking the public for help.

items.raw_excerpt: Winnipeg shoppers weren't too happy to hear that another Giant Tiger store is closing, saying it will be one less option to buy affordable groceries.

items.raw_excerpt: Men’s grooming brand Kahf posted the meme after Indonesia won the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup. Netizens criticised it for appearing to belittle Malaysia and other countries.
